Aurora Plate Loader Guide 

Cytek Loader Tutorial 

Start Up 

Make sure that tube is loaded onto Aurora for initial calibration of sample probe. 

Remove tube from holder once the initial calibration is completed and the Cytometer is showing ass “Connected.” 

Pull lever on loader to the front position. 

Turn on loader via the button in the back. 

Template Set Up 

Go to “Preferences” tab 

Under “Sample Delivery Mode” select “Plate” 

Check the box for “Bubble/Clog Detection” 

Return to “Acquisition” tab. 

Click “Add Plate” 

Select appropriate type of plate 

Label plate accordingly 

Click on “Edit” icon 

Select “Groups” tab 

Select wells that need to be acquired 

Can add multiple groups to a plate or make entire plate a single group 

Select “Acquisition” tab 

Set “Worksheet” to appropriate worksheet you would like to use 

Set “Events to Record” to an appropriate value 

Set “Storage Gate” to appropriate gate 

Set “Stopping Volume” to an appropriate vale 

We used 110 µL on Friday. 

Select “Loader Settings” tab 

Select the appropriate direction for sampling by selecting the arrow icons 

Set “Mix Time” to “4” 

All other settings should be fine. 

Sample Probe Depth Check 

Create a new plate with a sample only in well D1 

Use an empty plate and fill D1 with water or PBS 

Run the sample and look at the probe depth while running 

If sample probe appears to touch near the bottom of the plate, you are ready to run samples 

If sample probe is too high: 

Go to “QC& Setup” side tab 

Click on “Calibrate SIT” 

Change the value to a smaller number 

Run plate again to evaluate new SIT depth setting 

Run Plate 

Select a well to record data for 

Select an appropriate acquisition speed 

Click “Record” button and select “Record Well” 

If sample settings seem appropriate select “Record Plate” on “Record” button 

Shut Down 

Move the lever to adjust the loader to the off position (Move lever to the back) 

Turn off loader 

Under “ Preferences” Tab switch back to “Tube” under “Sample Delivery Method” 

Wash with Contrad 

Wash with Water 

Perform a “Fluidics Shutdown” and turn off Aurora  

Troubleshooting/Notes 

If plate holder is not in position to load a plate onto it click “Eject” button to return it to the proper position.
